cues: One rule, PS equals e times PM, gives all four conics.
The circle's centre and radius from the general form, and the tangency condition.
The parabola, ellipse and hyperbola with their foci, directrices and latus recta.
And the tangent at a point, by the T equals zero rule.
text: Quick recap. One rule, PS equals e times PM, gives all four conics. The circle's centre and radius from the general form, and the tangency condition. The parabola, ellipse and hyperbola with their foci, directrices and latus recta. And the tangent at a point, by the T equals zero rule.
